# Flux Kustomizations { .quad-reference }

Every Flux `Kustomization` the cluster runs, grouped by the layer that applies
it. For why the layers exist and what the prune and wait exceptions protect,
see [how Flux is layered](../explanation/flux-layering.md).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **`prune: false`** | `crds`, `namespaces` |
| **`wait: true`** | `crds` |
| **Declare `dependsOn`** | `platform-cluster`, `homer-services` |
| **Suspended in git** | none |
